svg.aria-label: generateapikey: an animated product tour. A key is generated, its checksum validated, hashed for storage, verified in constant time, then protected with TOTP MFA.
svg.text: API keys + MFA · 10 frameworks · zero dependencies

g.text: Store the hash, never the key.
Peppered HMAC. A database leak reveals nothing usable.
Never raises on attacker input. No early exit on a match.
